haikus.haiku:
Buns steam in sunshine
Golden fries dance with salt bright
Taste buds sing a cheer
Happy #NationalFastFoodDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Gentle breeze sings soft
Colors mingle in warm glow
Hands join hearts lift high
Happy #InternationalDayForTolerance from @ClamBakeSanta

Melody wakes dawn
Bright chords spill through cool air soft
Joy rings in warm glass
#HappyBirthdayWCHandy from @ClamBakeSanta
